answer: In PoA, EigenTrust centrality is computed from signed service interactions, then decayed with an exponential temporal half-life, so reputation requires sustained honest service rather than a brief pulse of activity. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity amplifies corroborated trust, while a freshly spawned sybil identity begins near zero centrality; without established paths through the trust plume or copper-linked peers, it cannot influence or pass consensus.
